name: ai.magnemo/magnemo
title: Magnemo
description: Persistent Memory for AI Agents, in plain local files. No network calls of its own.

environmentVariables.name: MAGNEMO_VAULT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the vault folder (create one with: magnemo init ./vault). Plain markdown files you own.

environmentVariables.name: MAGNEMO_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: The name this agent signs its entries with. Default: agent.
